exposure: prior cesarean delivery indications (arrest of dilation or descent)
outcome: Vaginal birth after cesarean delivery (VBAC) success
cohort: The study included 369 women attempting trial of labor after cesarean delivery (TOLAC) with a term singleton pregnancy and two prior cesarean deliveries from the Maternal-Fetal Medicine Units Network (MFMU) Cesarean Registry.
finding: The MFMU VBAC prediction model accurately predicts the likelihood of VBAC success in women with two prior cesarean deliveries, showing predicted probabilities similar to observed actual rates.
mod_finding: The MFMU prediction model effectively estimated the success rates of vaginal birth after cesarean delivery (VBAC) among women with two previous cesarean deliveries.
